profile.name: Vibhore
profile.source: simulated app profile; no account, native bridge, or analytics calls
profile.warning: Sidebar should label sample app data. Source platform totals and promotional copy are preserved design content, not verified live statistics. No query-injected profile or external profile endpoint exists.

integration.nativeActions: Local preview dialog. No deeplinks launched.
integration.share: Original html2canvas templates rendered into an accessible local preview dialog; no navigator.share or automatic download.

dependencies.fonts: Local Inter 400/500/600/700/800; original DM Serif Display italic and Material Symbols Rounded

preservation: 73 original assets byte-identical, including artwork and all three sounds. Original style.css retained. Original flipbook renderers, animations, question building and personality logic retained.
accessibility: Zoom enabled; named navigation controls, keyboard buttons, ArrowUp after answer to continue / ArrowDown to go back, dialog focus and Escape; hidden-tab audio pause; reduced-motion disables ambient loops and automatic progression.
validation: test-recap.mjs verifies sample segments, 6 personal / 5 inactive questions, correct answer indices, normalization, no native/network sharing, every live asset reference and source asset hashes.
limitations: Physical phone and native app not tested.
Auto-flip and source playful distractors retained; exact distractor options vary per reload.
Source retains 2025 campaign year and original offers as supplied.
wrapperEntry: index.html is the compendium viewer, replacing the archive entry. Runtime is experience.html.
